card.line: Gihon is the name of a river in Eden and also of a spring near Jerusalem, where Solomon was anointed king and Hezekiah secured the city's water.

moments.title: A river of Eden
moments.text: Gihon is named as the second river of Eden. It winds through the whole land of Cush.

moments.title: Solomon anointed king
moments.text: King David told his men to take Solomon down to Gihon. There Zadok the priest anointed Solomon, the horn was blown, and the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"

moments.title: Hezekiah redirects the spring
moments.text: Hezekiah shut off the upper outlet of the Spring of Gihon. He sent its water down the west side of the City of David, and he prospered in all he did.

moments.title: Manasseh builds the wall
moments.text: After the LORD brought him back to Jerusalem, Manasseh rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David from west of Gihon in the valley. He made it much higher.
